title: Epic Games Offers to Support all Generative AI Titles
author: Beginning-Chapter-26

comments.author: No_Industry9653
comments.body:
>Steam did not ban generative AI  submissions, and Sweeney knows this. In fact, they openly condone it, but in a way that is legally and ethically safe

Really pedantic point even if technically true since what Steam prohibits encompasses virtually all tools currently in use. "Ban games for using new technologies" is absolutely what they have done.
